facts.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 109% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+17%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+1%)

business.summary: Asian Paints Ltd. is India’s leading paint and décor company offering a wide range of interior and exterior wall finishes, waterproofing, home décor solutions, and industrial coatings, generating revenue through the sale of products and services across multiple geographies.

segments.name: Decorative and Home décor
segments.note: India's leading paint, décor and comprehensive home solution offerings.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Catering to households across Asia, Middle East, Africa and South Pacific.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.note: Custom-formulated products for automotive, general industrial, packaging and marine.

guidance.statement: Maintain the EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20% for the full year.
guidance.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.

guidance.statement: Expect volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
guidance.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.

guidance.statement: Expect full year volume growth to be in the band of 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

guidance.statement: Still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
guidance.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

guidance.statement: We are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth.
guidance.quote: So, while there could be a little bit of upstocking, which could happen because of the price increases, we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

guidance.statement: We should see how we can retain our margin guidance going forward.
guidance.quote: With a set of things which we are doing and some passing of some more price increases, we should see how we can retain our margin guidance going forward.

guidance.statement: Maintain volume growth in the high single-digit band of 8% to 10% in Q4
guidance.quote: So, as I said, I think the second quarter for us was at about 10.9%, this quarter is about a high-single-digit. I think as we go ahead, this band would remain, in terms of what we would be able to target for the Q4 as well.

guidance.statement: Endeavour to maintain PBDIT/EBITDA margin between the 18% and 20% band going ahead
guidance.quote: So, I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.

scorecard.promised: Maintain high single-digit volume growth band of 8% to 10% in Q4.
scorecard.delivered: Decorative volume growth achieved 12.4% in Mar 2026 quarter.
scorecard.evidence: Management claimed 12.4% decorative volume growth in Q4 FY26, beating the 8-10% targeted range.

scorecard.promised: Endeavour to maintain PBDIT/EBITDA margin between 18% and 20% band.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin was 19% in Mar 2026 quarter.
scorecard.evidence: Mar 2026 margin came in at 19%, landing right in the middle of the promised 18-20% band.

scorecard.promised: Expect full year volume growth in 8-10% band, later refined to 8-9% in H2.
scorecard.delivered: Decorative volume recorded 9% in Jun 2026 and 6.4% in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Guidance was narrowed from 8-10% to 8-9% after Q2 volume growth dropped to 6.4%.

scorecard.promised: Maintain full year EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20%.
scorecard.delivered: Margin was 21% in Jun 2026, but dropped to 16% in Sep 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Sep 2026 margin slipped to 16%, falling 200 bps short of the 18-20% target band.

narrative.scoreline: Management reliably delivers volume targets during stable periods but struggles to hold its 18-20% margin corridor when input cost pressures flare up.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Decorative volume grew at a strong 9% in Q1 FY27
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue grew 17.9% YoY in Jun 2026 to ₹10,542 crore.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Gross margins reached an all-time high of 45.6% in Q4 FY26 due to material deflation
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Quarterly margin hit 19% in Mar 2026 and jumped to 21% in Jun 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Good volume growth of 6.4% in Q2 FY27 demonstrates business resilience
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Quarterly operating margin broke down to 16% in Sep 2026, down from 18% a year prior.

bull: Strong free cash flow creation reaching ₹5,604 crore in Mar 2026 with 109% cash conversion over 5 years.
Top-line growth re-accelerated sharply with Jun 2026 revenue expanding 17.9% YoY to ₹10,542 crore.
New product innovations provide revenue support, contributing 18% of overall sales in Sep 2026 quarter.
bear: Margin vulnerability surfaced in Sep 2026 as operating margins dropped to 16%, missing guidance.
Volume growth decelerated from 12.4% in Mar 2026 down to 6.4% by Sep 2026.
Contingent liabilities totaling ₹488.74 crore present potential non-operational downside risk.
watch: Check if Sep 2026 operating margin recovers back above 18% in the Dec 2026 results.
Monitor if decorative volume growth rebounds back into the promised 8% to 9% range.

claims.claim: Achieved a good volume growth of 6.4% in decorative business despite high inflation and price hikes.
claims.quote: we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year

claims.claim: New products contribute about 18% to overall revenues.
claims.quote: today the new products contribute to about 18% of the revenues

claims.claim: Overall volume growth stood at a strong 9% for Q1, with rural markets outperforming urban markets.
claims.quote: Overall, we are at about a strong 9% volume growth. The growth has been across the months in this entire quarter.

claims.claim: Decorative value grew at 16.6%, aided by a weighted average price increase of about 6.8%.
claims.quote: If you look at the value, the decorative value has grown at a very good pitch of about 16.6%, albeit on a lower base.

claims.claim: New products within the portfolio contributed 17% to overall revenues in the quarter.
claims.quote: New products within the portfolio contribute 17% of our overall revenues.

claims.claim: International business grew at about 27% in Q1 with broad-based performance across regions.
claims.quote: This has yielded results. We have grown at about 27% in Q1. This has been a very strong performance.

claims.claim: The white cement plant is fully operational and VAM-VAE phase 1 will commence in August.
claims.quote: We have already completed our white cement plant, which is now fully operational and running at very good capacities in Fujairah, UAE.

claims.claim: The decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth and a value growth of 10.2% in the quarter.
claims.quote: When we look at the decorative business, we have achieved 12.4% volume growth and a very strong value growth of 10.2%.

claims.claim: Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6% amid a deflation of about 1.4% in the quarter.
claims.quote: taking our Gross Margins to almost an all-time high of about 45.6%, which is very strong.

claims.claim: We expect to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project in the first half of this year.
claims.quote: and for us, it is a signature project and we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

claims.claim: Q3 volume growth was 7.9% while value growth was 2.8%, indicating a strong product mix
claims.quote: So, overall, November and December, were good, which helped us basically prop the entire Q3 volume to about 7.9% growth. The value growth was about 2.8%

claims.claim: Rural markets batted better than urban centres in November and December due to good rainfall
claims.quote: One of the things which we saw was, that the rural parts batted better than the urban centres, possibly a good rainfall which has augured well.

claims.claim: The paint market experienced material deflation of about 1.1% in monomers and TiO2
claims.quote: And we see larger raw materials, whether it is monomers, whether it is TiO2 - the prices have been low. And we have seen a material deflation of about 1.1% as well

risks.text: Total contingent liabilities of Rs 488.74 crores including tax disputes, labour disputes, and a CCI complaint.
Extensive related-party transactions with promoter-controlled entities for raw materials and packaging materials.
Statutory and secretarial audit reports do not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark, or disclaimer.
Revenue recognition cut-off is identified as a key audit matter due to risk of misstatement.
